title: {{NAME}} and the Castle in the Dark
moral: Good friends help each other when things get scary.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} landed outside a big stone castle.
The castle lights had all gone out.
A princess looked out from a dark tower.
A tall silver robot stood at the gate.
Something had turned off all the power.

The princess called down to {{NAME}}.
"The robot cannot fix it alone," she said.
{{NAME}} looked up with a big surprised face.
"I will help!" he said bravely.
The robot beeped a thank-you beep.
